    "FUNCTION trint_tadir_interface.",
    "*\"----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "*\"*\"Lokale Schnittstelle:",
    "*\"  IMPORTING",
    "*\"     VALUE(WI_DELETE_TADIR_ENTRY) LIKE  TRPARI-S_CHECKED DEFAULT ' '",
    "*\"     VALUE(WI_REMOVE_REPAIR_FLAG) LIKE  TRPARI-S_CHECKED DEFAULT ' '",
    "*\"     VALUE(WI_SET_REPAIR_FLAG) LIKE  TRPARI-S_CHECKED DEFAULT ' '",
    "*\"     VALUE(WI_TEST_MODUS) LIKE  TRPARI-S_CHECKED DEFAULT 'X'",
    "*\"     VALUE(WI_TADIR_PGMID) LIKE  TADIR-PGMID",
    "*\"     VALUE(WI_TADIR_OBJECT) LIKE  TADIR-OBJECT",
    "*\"     VALUE(WI_TADIR_OBJ_NAME) LIKE  TADIR-OBJ_NAME",
    "*\"     VALUE(WI_TADIR_KORRNUM) LIKE  TADIR-KORRNUM DEFAULT ' '",
    "*\"     VALUE(WI_TADIR_SRCSYSTEM) LIKE  TADIR-SRCSYSTEM DEFAULT ' '",
    "*\"     VALUE(WI_TADIR_AUTHOR) LIKE  TADIR-AUTHOR DEFAULT ' '",
    "*\"     VALUE(WI_TADIR_DEVCLASS) LIKE  TADIR-DEVCLASS DEFAULT ' '",
    "*\"     VALUE(WI_TADIR_MASTERLANG) LIKE  TADIR-MASTERLANG DEFAULT ' '",
    "*\"     VALUE(WI_TADIR_CPROJECT) LIKE  TADIR-CPROJECT DEFAULT ' '",
    "*\"     VALUE(WI_TADIR_VERSID) LIKE  TADIR-VERSID DEFAULT ' '",
    "*\"     VALUE(WI_REMOVE_GENFLAG) LIKE  TRPARI-S_CHECKED DEFAULT ' '",
    "*\"     VALUE(WI_SET_GENFLAG) LIKE  TADIR-GENFLAG DEFAULT ' '",
    "*\"     VALUE(WI_READ_ONLY) LIKE  TRPARI-S_CHECKED DEFAULT ' '",
    "*\"     VALUE(IV_SET_EDTFLAG) LIKE  TADIR-EDTFLAG DEFAULT ' '",
    "*\"     VALUE(IV_WBO_INTERNAL) LIKE  TRPARI-FLAG DEFAULT ' '",
    "*\"     VALUE(IV_INSERT_MODE) LIKE  TRPARI-FLAG DEFAULT ' '",
    "*\"     VALUE(IV_TRANSL_TECH_TEXT) TYPE  TADIR-TRANSLTTXT DEFAULT ' '",
    "*\"     VALUE(IV_DELFLAG) TYPE  TADIR-DELFLAG DEFAULT ' '",
    "*\"     REFERENCE(IV_NO_PAK_CHECK) TYPE  TADIR-PAKNOCHECK DEFAULT ' '",
    "*\"     VALUE(IV_OBJ_STABILITY) TYPE  TADIR-OBJSTABLTY DEFAULT ' '",
    "*\"     VALUE(IV_TRANSL_TECH_TEXT_SUPP) TYPE  CHAR1 DEFAULT ' '",
    "*\"     VALUE(IV_DELFLAG_SUPP) TYPE  CHAR1 DEFAULT ''",
    "*\"     VALUE(IV_NO_PAK_CHECK_SUPP) TYPE  CHAR1 DEFAULT ' '",
    "*\"     VALUE(IV_OBJ_STABILITY_SUPP) TYPE  CHAR1 DEFAULT ' '",
    "*\"     VALUE(WI_TADIR_CHECK_DATE) TYPE  TADIR-CHECK_DATE DEFAULT ''",
    "*\"     VALUE(WI_TADIR_CHECK_CFG) TYPE  TADIR-CHECK_CFG DEFAULT '~'",
    "*\"  EXPORTING",
    "*\"     VALUE(NEW_GTADIR_ENTRY) LIKE  GTADIR STRUCTURE  GTADIR",
    "*\"     VALUE(NEW_TADIR_ENTRY) LIKE  TADIR STRUCTURE  TADIR",
    "*\"  EXCEPTIONS",
    "*\"      TADIR_ENTRY_NOT_EXISTING",
    "*\"      TADIR_ENTRY_ILL_TYPE",
    "*\"      NO_SYSTEMNAME",
    "*\"      NO_SYSTEMTYPE",
    "*\"      ORIGINAL_SYSTEM_CONFLICT",
    "*\"      OBJECT_RESERVED_FOR_DEVCLASS",
    "*\"      OBJECT_EXISTS_GLOBAL",
    "*\"      OBJECT_EXISTS_LOCAL",
    "*\"      OBJECT_IS_DISTRIBUTED",
    "*\"      OBJ_SPECIFICATION_NOT_UNIQUE",
    "*\"      NO_AUTHORIZATION_TO_DELETE",
    "*\"      DEVCLASS_NOT_EXISTING",
    "*\"      SIMULTANIOUS_SET_REMOVE_REPAIR",
    "*\"      ORDER_MISSING",
    "*\"      NO_MODIFICATION_OF_HEAD_SYST",
    "*\"      PGMID_OBJECT_NOT_ALLOWED",
    "*\"      MASTERLANGUAGE_NOT_SPECIFIED",
    "*\"      DEVCLASS_NOT_SPECIFIED",
    "*\"      SPECIFY_OWNER_UNIQUE",
    "*\"      LOC_PRIV_OBJS_NO_REPAIR",
    "*\"      GTADIR_NOT_REACHED",
    "*\"      OBJECT_LOCKED_FOR_ORDER",
    "*\"      CHANGE_OF_CLASS_NOT_ALLOWED",
    "*\"      NO_CHANGE_FROM_SAP_TO_TMP",
    "*\"----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "  DATA: ls_tadir                 LIKE tadir,",
    "        ls_e071                  LIKE e071,",
    "        ls_lock_key              LIKE tlock_int,",
    "        ls_tdevc                 LIKE tdevc,",
    "        lv_masterflag            LIKE trpari-s_checked,",
    "        lv_name_too_long_for_old LIKE trpari-s_checked,",
    "        lv_namespace             LIKE trnspace-namespace,",
    "        lv_nonstandard_chars     LIKE trpari-s_checked,",
    "        lq_tadir_entry_exists(1) TYPE c,",
    "        lv_force_mode            LIKE trpari-flag.",
    "",
    "",
    "",
    "***   Initialization ***************************************************",
    "  CLEAR: new_tadir_entry, sy-msgid, sy-msgty, sy-msgno,",
    "         sy-msgv1, sy-msgv2, sy-msgv3, sy-msgv4, new_gtadir_entry.",
    "",
    "*** fill import parameter into structure *******************************",
    "  ls_tadir-pgmid      =    wi_tadir_pgmid.",
    "  ls_tadir-object     =    wi_tadir_object.",
    "  ls_tadir-obj_name   =    wi_tadir_obj_name.",
    "  ls_tadir-korrnum    =    wi_tadir_korrnum.",
    "  ls_tadir-srcsystem  =    wi_tadir_srcsystem.",
    "  ls_tadir-author     =    wi_tadir_author.",
    "  ls_tadir-devclass   =    wi_tadir_devclass.",
    "  ls_tadir-masterlang =    wi_tadir_masterlang.",
    "  ls_tadir-cproject   =    wi_tadir_cproject.",
    "  ls_tadir-versid     =    wi_tadir_versid.",
    "  ls_tadir-paknocheck =    iv_no_pak_check.",
    "  ls_tadir-objstablty =    iv_obj_stability.",
    "  ls_tadir-TRANSLTTXT = iv_transl_tech_text .",
    "  ls_tadir-delflag = iv_delflag.",
    "  ls_tadir-check_date =    wi_tadir_check_date.",
    "  ls_tadir-check_cfg  =    wi_tadir_check_cfg.",
    "",
    "",
    "*** check: repair/genflag parameter ************************************",
    "  IF ( wi_set_repair_flag  =  'X'  AND wi_remove_repair_flag = 'X' )",
    "  OR ( wi_set_genflag     <> space AND wi_remove_genflag     = 'X' ).",
    "    MESSAGE e212(tr)  RAISING simultanious_set_remove_repair.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "  IF wi_set_genflag NA gc_genflag_values.",
    "    MESSAGE e249(tr)  RAISING simultanious_set_remove_repair.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "",
    "*** ensure, that devclass for R3TR DEVC is always itself ***************",
    "  IF   ls_tadir-object     =    'DEVC'.",
    "    ls_tadir-devclass   =    ls_tadir-obj_name.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "",
    "  CALL FUNCTION 'TR_AUTHORITY_CHECK_ADMIN'",
    "    EXPORTING",
    "      iv_adminfunction = 'TABL'",
    "    EXCEPTIONS",
    "      e_no_authority   = 1.",
    "  IF sy-subrc = 0.",
    "    lv_masterflag = 'X'.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "",
    "*** read: system parameters ********************************************",
    "  PERFORM get_system_parameters.",
    "",
    "*** check: only R3TR/R3OB/ LIMU COMM (no HEAD SYST) allowed ************",
    "  PERFORM check_pgmid_and_object_ok    USING ls_tadir.",
    "",
    "*** check: correct tadir-type (typecheck ca 'TL' & no R3TR DEVC $ ) ****",
    "  PERFORM check_tadir_vs_e071_1  USING lv_name_too_long_for_old",
    "                                       ls_tadir",
    "                                       ls_e071",
    "                                       ls_lock_key",
    "                                       lv_namespace",
    "                                       lv_nonstandard_chars.",
    "",
    "*** read: database version of TADIR and GTADIR *************************",
    "  PERFORM read_tadir_gtadir            USING ls_tadir",
    "                                             new_tadir_entry",
    "                                             new_gtadir_entry",
    "                                             lq_tadir_entry_exists.",
    "**for new entries allow only  SyCharSet-characters  ********************",
    "  PERFORM sy_char_set_check  USING lq_tadir_entry_exists",
    "                                   lv_nonstandard_chars.",
    "",
    "************************************************************************",
    "  IF lq_tadir_entry_exists >< space",
    "  AND iv_insert_mode       >< space.",
    "    lq_tadir_entry_exists = space.",
    "    lv_force_mode         = 'X'.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "",
    "*** 1. case: read-only-modus (local TADIR and global GTADIR ) **********",
    "  IF   wi_read_only   =    'X'.",
    "    IF   lq_tadir_entry_exists    =    space.",
    "      MESSAGE   e753(tk)",
    "                WITH    ls_tadir-pgmid ls_tadir-object",
    "                        ls_tadir-obj_name",
    "                RAISING tadir_entry_not_existing.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    EXIT.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "",
    "*** 2. case: delete TADIR **********************************************",
    "  IF   wi_delete_tadir_entry    =    'X'.",
    "    IF   lq_tadir_entry_exists    =    space.",
    "      MESSAGE e245(tr)",
    "              WITH    ls_tadir-pgmid  ls_tadir-object",
    "                      ls_tadir-obj_name",
    "                      RAISING tadir_entry_not_existing.",
    "    ELSE.",
    "      PERFORM delete_tadir__entry USING new_tadir_entry",
    "                                        wi_test_modus.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    EXIT.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "",
    "*** check: development class  ******************************************",
    "  PERFORM check_development_class1    USING ls_tadir",
    "                                            new_tadir_entry",
    "                                            ls_tdevc",
    "                                            lq_tadir_entry_exists",
    "                                            wi_set_genflag",
    "                                            wi_remove_genflag.",
    "",
    "*** prepare TADIR-structure before update ******************************",
    "  PERFORM fill_tadir_from__input  USING ls_tadir",
    "                                        ls_tdevc",
    "                                        new_tadir_entry",
    "                                        lq_tadir_entry_exists",
    "                                        wi_set_genflag",
    "                                        wi_set_repair_flag",
    "                                        wi_remove_genflag",
    "                                        wi_remove_repair_flag",
    "                                        lv_masterflag",
    "                                        iv_set_edtflag",
    "                                        new_gtadir_entry",
    "                                        iv_wbo_internal",
    "                                        iv_transl_tech_text_supp",
    "                                        iv_delflag_supp",
    "                                        IV_NO_PAK_CHECK_supp",
    "                                        IV_OBJ_STABILITY_supp  .",
    "",
    "***check namespace and delivery unit vs devclass",
    "  PERFORM check_nsp_du_vs_devc USING new_tadir_entry",
    "                                        ls_tdevc",
    "                                        lv_namespace",
    "                                        lq_tadir_entry_exists",
    "                                        wi_read_only.",
    "***check package restrictions",
    "  PERFORM check_package_restrictions USING new_tadir_entry",
    "                                           lq_tadir_entry_exists.",
    "",
    "",
    "",
    "",
    "*** database-update TADIR **********************************************",
    "  PERFORM modify_tadir  USING new_tadir_entry",
    "                               lq_tadir_entry_exists",
    "                               wi_test_modus",
    "                               lv_force_mode.",
    "ENDFUNCTION."
  ],
